rationale: Priyal brings hands-on data engineering and analytics expertise (SQL, Python, data warehousing) that could strengthen Loop UX's backend capabilities, while Lene's founder experience building a design-focused product and deep systems-level work in functional programming and data structures offer valuable perspective on scaling technical infrastructure. Both share Python in their stack and complement each other well—Priyal's analytics focus paired with Lene's architectural rigor could unlock new product or operational opportunities.
intro_message: Priyal Panda, meet Lene Leth Rasmussen — Lene founded Loop UX and has deep systems expertise; Priyal specializes in data warehouses and analytics automation and could bring valuable backend perspective to UX-driven products.
